title: manifest — case shape (v0.1)
description: Pins the byte-level contract for the canonical vault-head manifest object (MYND-414 / SYNC-13; spec docs/spec/sync-protocol.md §4.2). The manifest is the uuid->content_nonce map of content blobs only (notes by note-UUID, attachments by attachment-id; 16-byte ids, 24-byte content_nonce), encoded encode-then-hash with a manifest-specific hash domain prefix (§3.5) so it can never be reinterpreted as a head record. The vault head commits manifest_hash = SHA-256(manifest_canonical) (§3.2). Two case kinds: 'encode' pins the canonical manifest bytes + manifest_hash (covering the ascending-by-id sort and the empty/single/multi/tombstone shapes); 'parse_fail' pins the distinguishable structural decode rejects. Reference: protocol::manifest (encode_manifest / compute_manifest_hash / decode_manifest); cross-impl bit-identical output is the acceptance bar.

input_id_hex.description: 16-byte content-blob id (hex): a note UUID or an attachment-id. The flat content keyspace (sync-protocol.md §4.2).

input_content_nonce_hex.description: 24-byte content_nonce (hex) — the blob's current per-revision rollback discriminator (protocol.md §9.2). A `deleted`-marked tombstone version carries its own fresh content_nonce.

vector_id.description: Stable identifier of the form 'manifest/v0.1/<descriptive-slug>'. Immutable once shipped.

oneOf.title: encode — pin the canonical manifest bytes and manifest_hash

input_entries.description: The manifest's (id, content_nonce) entries. MAY be supplied UNSORTED to pin that the encoder sorts entries ascending by id (byte-order); the expected output reflects the canonical order. No id may repeat.

expected_manifest_bytes_hex.description: The full canonical manifest_canonical bytes (hex): 'myne.v0.1|vault-manifest|' || protocol_version(0x01) || manifest_format_version(0x01) || entry_count(4 BE) || per entry sorted-ascending-by-id: id(16) || content_nonce(24).

expected_manifest_hash_hex.description: 32-byte manifest_hash = SHA-256(manifest_canonical), hex — the value the vault head commits in head_mac_input (sync-protocol.md §3.2 / §4.2).

oneOf.title: parse_fail — pin a distinguishable structural decode reject

input_manifest_bytes_hex.description: Tampered/malformed manifest bytes (hex) a conformant decoder MUST reject before trusting any field.

expected_error.description: The structural reject a conformant decoder returns (maps to protocol::manifest::ManifestError).
